memory_update.content: For the Education theme, prioritize regulated education capacity, professional licensure gates, LMS/workflow infrastructure, and employer-funded learning over high-attention consumer edtech unless the consumer platform is used only as a reference benchmark.
AFYA, LAUR, D2L, and DCBO should advance to deeper Layer 4 evidence checks because they combine underfollowed discovery with testable bottleneck hypotheses.
BNED and SKIL should remain speculative_shadow candidates until liquidity, debt, retention, and solvency risks are verified from primary filings.

COUR and DUOL are useful reference anchors for online-learning valuation, engagement, and AI-product expectations, but should not crowd out underfollowed infrastructure or regulated-capacity candidates.
